title: Model Checks, Pings, and Alerts
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Model Checks, Pings, and Alerts.
learning_objectives: Explain model checks, pings, and alerts using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for model checks, pings, and alerts
Assess failure and operational limits of model checks, pings, and alerts
concepts_covered: A Check is a monitored job; Ping records a heartbeat; AlertChannel describes destinations and Alert stores sent events.
Check includes schedule/grace/timeout/status fields; Ping/Alert reference the check.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
